figurative_meaning_bn: ডোলের মত ফাঁপা বা ফোলা অবস্থা
figurative_meaning_en: A swollen or bloated state like a drum
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পেট ফুলে ঢোল হয়ে গেছে।
আলু টা এত ফুলে ঢোল দেখাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His stomach has swollen up like a drum.
The potato looks bloated like a drum.
note: The idiom draws from the round, taut shape of a traditional Bengali drum (ঢোল), commonly used in folk music and festivals.
